Subject: Re: W-8BEN-E uploaded - EIN/Legal name mismatch (PO on hold)

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and for uploading the W-8BEN-E. Short answer: we have three pragmatic paths to clear the PO gate.

1) Bank letter (preferred): A bank-issued letter on letterhead that ties the EIN to the legal entity name and confirms account ownership. PDF is fine; must include bank contact info.

2) Notarized corporate affidavit: Notarized statement from the corporate secretary describing the recent consolidation and legal-name alias with EIN.

3) DocuSign signed power/authorization + secondary identity proof: If you provide a DocuSign envelope showing an authorized signer and a recent bank letter or government filing as secondary evidence, Procurement can accept that for a conditional PO release.

Note on timing: with the bank letter we can move to "provisional PO" status within 24 business hours and Finance will issue payment terms. With notarized affidavit it’s typically 2-3 business days for verification. If you go DocuSign+bank doc, we aim for the 48-hour window.

Please attach whichever you prefer to this thread. If you want, we can also accept a certified transcript of the EIN from the country registry (if available).

I'll loop Ben (finance intake) and Marcus (procurement ops) to confirm any additional fields Finance needs on the bank letter.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
--

If Tide prefers the notarized affidavit route, Finance will need a copy of the corporate minutes or a recent board resolution that aligns with the affidavit.
